title: FDA approves daraxonrasib for metastatic pancreatic adenocarcinoma
content:
Evidence for efficacy is based on the results of the RASolute 302 study
On 26 August 2026, the US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) approved daraxonrasib (RASONQUE, Revolution Medicines, Inc.), an inhibitor of the RAS GTPase family, for adult patients with metastatic pancreatic adenocarcinoma who have received at least one prior systemic therapy or who are not candidates for multiagent systemic therapy.
Efficacy was evaluated in RASolute 302 (NCT06625320), a randomised, open-label, multicentre study conducted in patients with metastatic pancreatic adenocarcinoma with disease progression after receiving one prior line of systemic therapy. A total of 500 patients were randomised 1:1 to receive either daraxonrasib or physician’s choice of standard-of-care (SOC) chemotherapy regimens.
Major efficacy outcome measures were overall survival (OS) and progression-free survival (PFS) as assessed by blinded independent central review in patients with a RAS G12 mutation and in the overall population. Objective response rate (ORR) was an additional outcome measure. The study demonstrated a statistically significant improvement in OS, PFS, and ORR for patients treated with daraxonrasib compared to SOC chemotherapy, both in the RAS G12 population and in the overall population.
In the overall population, median OS was 13.2 months (95% confidence interval [CI] 10.0, not estimable [NE]) in the daraxonrasib arm and 6.7 months (95% CI 5.8, 8.0) in the SOC arm (hazard ratio [HR] 0.40, 95% CI 0.30, 0.53; p-value < 0.0001). Median PFS was 7.2 months (95% CI 5.7, 7.5) in the daraxonrasib arm and 3.6 months (95% CI 2.9, 4.2) in the SOC arm (HR 0.49, 95% CI 0.38, 0.64; p-value < 0.0001). ORR was 30% (95% CI 25, 36) and 11% (95% CI 7, 15) in the respective arms (p-value < 0.0001).
The daraxonrasib prescribing information includes warnings and precautions for dermatologic and soft tissue toxicity, stomatitis and oral disorders, diarrhoea, gastrointestinal perforation, interstitial lung disease (ILD)/pneumonitis, and embryo-foetal toxicity.
The recommended daraxonrasib dose is 300 mg orally once daily until disease progression or unacceptable toxicity.
This review was conducted under Project Orbis , an initiative of the FDA’s Oncology Center of Excellence (OCE) . Project Orbis provides a framework for concurrent submission and review of oncology drugs among international partners. For this review, FDA collaborated with Health Canada. The European Medicines Agency and Japan’s Pharmaceuticals and Medical Devices Agency were official observers of this review. The applications may still be under review at the other regulatory agencies.
This review used the Real-Time Oncology Review  pilot programme, which streamlined data submission prior to the filing of the entire clinical application, and the Assessment Aid, a voluntary submission from the applicant to facilitate the FDA’s assessment. The FDA approved this application approximately 6.5 months ahead of the FDA goal date.
This application is part of the FDA Commissioner’s National Priority Review Voucher pilot programme , which is designed to accelerate the review of products with the potential to address key national priorities. Daraxonrasib received breakthrough therapy designation and orphan drug designation.
Healthcare professionals should report all serious adverse events suspected to be associated with the use of any medicine and device to FDA’s MedWatch Reporting System.
For assistance with single-patient INDs for investigational oncology products, healthcare professionals may contact OCE’s Project Facilitate .

title: EMA recommends extension of therapeutic indications for trastuzumab deruxtecan
content:
New indication concerns monotherapy in the adjuvant treatment for adult patients with resected HER2-positive breast cancer who have residual invasive disease after neoadjuvant taxane-based and HER2-targeted treatment
On 17 September 2026, the European Medicines Agency’s (EMA’s) Committee for Medicinal Products for Human Use (CHMP) adopted a positive opinion, recommending a change to the terms of the marketing authorisation for the medicinal product trastuzumab deruxtecan (Enhertu).
The marketing authorisation holder for this medicinal product is Daiichi Sankyo Europe GmbH.
The CHMP adopted a new indication as follows:
Early breast cancer
Enhertu as monotherapy is indicated for the adjuvant treatment of adult patients with resected HER2-positive breast cancer who have residual invasive disease after neoadjuvant taxane-based and HER2-targeted treatment.
For information, the full indications for Enhertu will be as follows ( new indication in bold ):
Early breast cancer
Enhertu as monotherapy is indicated for the adjuvant treatment of adult patients with resected HER2-positive breast cancer who have residual invasive disease after neoadjuvant taxane-based and HER2-targeted treatment.
Metastatic breast cancer
Enhertu in combination with pertuzumab is indicated for the first-line treatment of adult patients with unresectable or metastatic HER2-positive breast cancer.
Enhertu as monotherapy is indicated for the treatment of adult patients with unresectable or metastatic HER2-positive breast cancer who have received one or more prior anti-HER2-based regimens.
HER2-low and HER2-ultralow breast cancer
Enhertu as monotherapy is indicated for the treatment of adult patients with unresectable or metastatic
hormone receptor (HR)-positive, HER2-low or HER2-ultralow breast cancer who have received at least one endocrine therapy in the metastatic setting and who are not considered suitable for endocrine therapy as the next line of treatment.
HER2-low breast cancer who have received prior chemotherapy in the metastatic setting or developed disease recurrence during or within 6 months of completing adjuvant chemotherapy.
Non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC)
Enhertu as monotherapy is indicated for the treatment of adult patients with advanced NSCLC whose tumours have an activating HER2 ( ERBB2 ) mutation and who require systemic therapy following platinum-based chemotherapy with or without immunotherapy.
Gastric cancer
Enhertu as monotherapy is indicated for the treatment of adult patients with advanced HER2-positive gastric or gastro-oesophageal junction (GEJ) adenocarcinoma who have received a prior trastuzumab-based regimen.
Other unresectable or metastatic solid tumours
Enhertu as monotherapy is indicated for the treatment of adult patients with unresectable or metastatic HER2-positive (IHC3+) solid tumours who have received prior treatment and who have no satisfactory treatment options.
Detailed recommendations for the use of this product will be described in the updated summary of product characteristics, which will be published on the EMA website in all official European Union languages after a decision on this change to the marketing authorisation has been granted by the European Commission.
Summary of positive opinion are published without prejudice to the Commission decision, which will normally be issued 67 days from adoption of the opinion.

title: 一针CAR T细胞疗法让僵人综合征患者重获行走能力：2期试验一年数据显示显著改善，有望冲击FDA首个获批疗法
content:
一针CAR T细胞疗法让僵人综合征患者重获行走能力：2期试验一年数据显示显著改善，有望冲击FDA首个获批疗法
来源：生物谷原创 2026-10-23 09:58
这项注册性临床试验的发现正在帮助推动miv-cel朝潜在FDA批准迈进。开发该CAR T细胞疗法的生物制药公司Kyverna已表示，打算在2026年第四季度完成其滚动生物制品许可申请（BLA）提交。
由科罗拉多大学安舒茨分校领导的新研究为僵人综合征（stiff person syndrome, SPS）患者带来希望，显示一种CAR T细胞疗法可能帮助改变疾病进程，患者在治疗后至少一年内移动能力和整体残疾状况获得显著改善。
SPS是一种罕见的、进行性自身免疫性神经系统疾病，导致使人衰弱的肌肉僵硬、疼痛性痉挛和行走困难。估计80%的患者最终需要行走辅助或轮椅，许多人面临永久性残疾的风险。
这项2期临床试验由Kyverna Therapeutics公司申办，由主要研究者、科罗拉多大学安舒茨分校医学院自身免疫神经病学项目主任Amanda Piquet医学博士领导，评估了一种名为mivocabtagene autoleucel（miv-cel）的实验性CAR T细胞疗法。一年期结果于2026年10月21日在MSToronto26上公布，该国际会议聚焦多发性硬化及相关神经系统疾病进展。
Piquet分享说，在接受单次实验性治疗后一年，SPS患者在移动能力方面表现出显著改善，完成25英尺步行测试的时间几乎为治疗前的一半。此外，最初需要行走辅助的患者中有三分之二能够在无辅助情况下完成步行测试。除行走改善外，患者的肌肉僵硬、对刺激的敏感性和整体残疾也获得持久减轻。
“这些发现如此令人兴奋的原因在于，我们看到患者重获独立，做以前没有辅助无法做的事情。对于一种没有获批疗法的进行性疾病，这些发现代表向前迈出的重要一步，”Piquet说。
该治疗使用患者自身的免疫细胞，这些细胞被改造以靶向参与该疾病的细胞。与通常需要持续用药来控制症状和抑制免疫活性的传统治疗不同，这种方法旨在解决驱动SPS的潜在自身免疫过程，可能在单次治疗后提供更持久的获益。
一年期的关键发现
临床试验中治疗的全部26名患者均完成了一年研究，使研究人员能够评估最初几个月中观察到的改善是否随时间持续。
（1）行走能力显著改善：单次治疗后一年，患者完成25英尺步行测试的中位时间比治疗前减少49%。
（2）对行走辅助的需求减少：在最初需要行走辅助完成步行测试的12名患者中，有8名（67%）在一年时不再需要辅助完成测试。
（3）步行时间与健康成人相当：超过三分之一患者（35%）在5秒内完成25英尺步行测试，这一时间与典型健康成人相当。
（4）对持续免疫治疗的依赖减少：一年时，26名患者中有24名（92%）仍未使用抑制或调节免疫系统以管理SPS的治疗。
（5）免疫细胞回升后获益仍持续：在65%的患者中，治疗所靶向的免疫细胞在一年时已开始回升，但临床改善得以维持。这提示该疗法可能对潜在自身免疫疾病产生更持久的影响，而不仅仅是提供暂时的症状缓解。
潜在FDA批准
这项注册性临床试验的发现正在帮助推动miv-cel朝潜在FDA批准迈进。开发该CAR T细胞疗法的生物制药公司Kyverna已表示，打算在2026年第四季度完成其滚动生物制品许可申请（BLA）提交。
如果获批，miv-cel可能成为首个专门针对僵人综合征获得FDA批准的疗法，以及首个获批用于自身免疫性疾病的CAR T细胞疗法。
“CAR T细胞疗法有潜力改变我们治疗自身免疫疾病的方式，提供持久改善而无需持续免疫治疗，”Piquet说。“我们希望这能带来首个获批用于僵人综合征的疗法，并为治疗自身免疫疾病打开一种全新方法的大门。”（生物谷Bioon.com）

title: First-line triplet regimen significantly prolongs progression-free survival in BRAF V600-mutant melanoma
content:
The STARBOARD study supports treatment intensification and reports a predictable safety profile for the combination
Final analysis results of the STARBOARD trial have demonstrated a meaningful, highly statistically significant clinical benefit with a pembrolizumab triplet regimen versus standard dual therapy in patients with unresectable locally advanced or metastatic melanoma , as reported at ESMO Congress 2026 (Madrid, 23–27 October) ( Abstract 2071O ).
For patients with BRAF V600-mutant metastatic melanoma, the current first-line standard of care is an immune checkpoint inhibitor(s) or other immunotherapy combination , often without BRAF or MEK inhibitors ( Ann Oncol. 2025;36:10–30 ). However, there is good rationale to combine these agents; immune changes have been identified within the tumour microenvironment in patients who respond to BRAF or MEK inhibitors, suggesting that they may show increased sensitivity to immunotherapy ( JAMA Oncol. 2020;6:1957–1966 ). The progression-free survival (PFS) benefits of triplet regimens versus BRAF–MEK inhibitor combinations have also been demonstrated previously in this setting ( Lancet. 2020;395:1835–1844 ; Nat Med. 2019;25:941–946 ).
The study met both the primary and key secondary endpoints. The confirmed objective response rate (ORR; primary endpoint) was 70.0% in the triplet arm (pembrolizumab plus encorafenib and binimetinib; n=110) compared with 32.7% in the control arm (pembrolizumab plus placebo; n=110); odds ratio 4.903; p<0.0001. Median PFS was also significantly extended with the triplet regimen (33.0 months versus 3.4 months, respectively), resulting in a 67% reduction in the risk of disease progression or death compared with standard therapy (hazard ratio 0.33; 90% confidence interval 0.24–0.46; p<0.0001).
“The improved PFS from combined use of immunotherapy and targeted therapy as first-line treatment is great to see but this strategy ‘burns two bullets’ that could be used sequentially if needed as later-line therapy, so it will be important to know whether the significantly extended PFS translates into prolonged overall survival (OS),” cautions Dr Olivier Michielin from Geneva University Hospital, Switzerland noting that OS data were immature at data cut-off, while a positive trend towards improved OS was observed in the triplet arm.
“Prior studies in BRAF V600-mutant metastatic melanoma have explored targeted therapy plus or minus immunotherapy. This study has reversed the randomisation to evaluate immunotherapy plus or minus targeted therapy,” highlights Michielin. Previously reported SECOMBIT ( Nat Commun. 2024;15:146 ) and DREAMseq ( J Clin Oncol. 2023;41:186–197 ) trials have already established that first-line immunotherapy is associated with more favourable outcomes than first-line targeted therapy in the BRAF -mutated population.
Despite impressive ORR and PFS benefits in the STARBOARD experimental arm, “Presented data showed the added toxicity of treatment intensification , although the most common adverse events such as nausea, diarrhoea, vomiting, fatigue and elevated liver enzymes are known toxicities that we have experience in managing,” observes Michielin.
Grade 3–4 treatment-emergent adverse events (TEAEs) were reported in 70.0% of patients in the STARBOARD triplet arm versus 39.1% of those in the control arm. While no new safety signals and no grade 5 treatment-related adverse events (TRAEs) were observed, data from an earlier safety lead-in investigating different doses of encorafenib in the triplet regimen reported a high incidence of serious TEAEs (up to 50% of patients) and serious TRAEs (up to 20% of patients) ( Eur J Cancer. 2024;213:115070 ). In the earlier study, permanent discontinuation of pembrolizumab owing to TRAEs also occurred in up to 25% of patients and permanent discontinuation of encorafenib or binimetinib in up to 15% of patients.
“A key research question will be to compare the currently recommended treatment approach for metastatic BRAF V600-mutant melanoma of first-line immunotherapy , especially using double checkpoint inhibition, followed by targeted therapy at relapse ( Ann Oncol. 2025;36:10–30 ) with the STARBOARD triplet regimen. There is still work to be done to determine how and when to use these agents for optimal activity and safety,” he concludes.

title: Chemotherapy-free regimen of targeted agent and immunotherapeutic superior to imatinib and chemotherapy among adult patients with Ph-positive ALL
content:
Findings from the GIMEMA ALL2820 study
In a phase III GIMEMA ALL2820 study, the investigators documented the superiority of a frontline chemotherapy-free targeted and immunotherapeutic approach over conventional treatment in adult patients with newly diagnosed Philadelphia-positive (Ph-positive) acute lymphoblastic leukaemia (ALL). The results confirm the superiority of the chemotherapy-free approach, with significantly longer event-free survival (EFS), the study primary endpoint, in the intervention group that received ponatinib and blinatumomab than in the control group of patients who received imatinib and chemotherapy.
Although formal hypothesis testing was not conducted for secondary endpoints, results of analyses of haematologic and molecular responses, as well as the incidence of relapse and overall survival (OS), also favoured the intervention group according to Dr. Robin Foà of the Department of Translational and Precision Medicine, Sapienza University in Rome, Italy and colleagues from Gruppo Italiano Malattie Ematologiche dell’Adulto (GIMEMA), who published the findings on 14 October 2026 in the NEJM .
The authors wrote in the background that outcomes in patients with Ph-positive ALL have greatly improved since the introduction of tyrosine kinase inhibitors (TKIs). With the frontline use of imatinib, the first-in-class inhibitor, alone or in combination with chemotherapy, followed by allogeneic haematopoietic stem-cell transplantation when feasible, OS increased from 20% to 60%. These results have improved further with the use of second- and third-generation TKIs dasatinib and ponatinib, alone or in combination with chemotherapy.
A further substantial improvement has come with the addition of immunotherapy, the bispecific CD19-targeting monoclonal antibody blinatumomab. In the GIMEMA LAL2116 D-ALBA study, the GIMEMA researchers reported the feasibility of a chemotherapy-free induction and consolidation approach with dasatinib, followed by two to five cycles of blinatumomab, in adult patients with newly diagnosed Ph-positive ALL. The long-term follow-up (53 months) showed disease-free survival (DFS), OS, and EFS of 75.8%, 80.7%, and 74.6%, respectively.
To formally prove that a chemotherapy-free strategy is superior to a TKI plus chemotherapy, the GIMEMA investigators designed the GIMEMA ALL2820 study, in which the intervention group received ponatinib, followed by two to five cycles of intravenous blinatumomab, and the control group received imatinib (the only TKI that had been approved worldwide for frontline treatment when the study was designed) and chemotherapy. The primary goal of this study was to evaluate the efficacy of a frontline targeted therapy plus immunotherapy strategy, as compared with imatinib plus chemotherapy, in terms of molecular response, EFS, and molecular EFS in adult patients with Ph-positive ALL.
Patients were randomly assigned in a 2:1 ratio to receive ponatinib plus blinatumomab (intervention group) or imatinib plus chemotherapy (control group) as frontline treatment. A crossover to the intervention group was allowed for patients with persistence or reappearance of measurable residual disease (MRD) in the control group. A total of 236 patients underwent randomisation: 158 to the intervention group and 78 to the control group. The median age of the patients was 55 years (range, 24 to 82).
At a median follow-up of 23.7 months, the estimated 24-month EFS was 86% (95% confidence interval [CI] 80 to 92) in the intervention group and 67% (95% CI 56 to 79) in the control group (p < 0.001). Molecular EFS was 68% (95% CI 61 to 76) in the intervention group and 42% (95% CI 32 to 55) in the control group.
Similarly, OS estimates were 90% (95% CI 85 to 95) in the intervention group and 85% (95% CI 78 to 94) in the control group. The effect of crossover is documented by an OS of 96% (95% CI 90 to 100) among the patients who switched from the control group to the intervention group. The cumulative incidence of relapse was 5% (95% CI 1 to 8) in the intervention group and 13% (95% CI 3 to 22) in the control group. The corresponding DFS was 91% (95% CI 86 to 96) and 84% (95% CI 74 to 95).
By the end of induction (day 70), a complete haematologic response was reported in 149 of 158 patients (94%) in the intervention group and in 62 of 78 patients (79%) in the control group. Deaths during induction were reported in 4 patients (3%) in the intervention group and in 7 patients (9%) in the control group. Treatment discontinuation because of side effects was reported in 5 patients (3%) in the intervention group. In the control group, 6 patients (8%) discontinued treatment, 2 had resistance to treatment, and 1 had an early relapse.
By the end of induction (day 70), the intention-to-treat molecular analysis showed a molecular response (complete molecular response or a positive non-quantifiable response) in 74 patients (47%) in the intervention group and in 34 patients (44%) in the control group. After consolidation (day 133), a molecular response was recorded in 112 patients (71%) in the intervention group and in 38 patients (49%) in the control group.
A total of 17 relapses occurred: in 9 of 149 patients (6%) in the intervention group and in 8 of 62 patients (13%) in the control group. In the intervention group, 5 relapses occurred during treatment, including a single central nervous system (CNS) relapse and a nodal relapse originating from a Ph-negative clone, and 4 relapses occurred in patients who had prematurely stopped treatment because of side effects.
An IKZF1 plus signature was identified in 5 patients. An ABL1 mutation developed in 3 patients (2 patients with T315I and 1 patient with both E255K and Y253H ) and in another 2 patients after treatment interruption. Five patients died after having had a complete haematologic response, 4 from transplantation-related causes and 1 from cardiac arrest. In total, 3 patients withdrew from treatment: 1 because of a myocardial infarction, 1 because of a fungal infection, and 1 because of personal reasons.
In the control group, 4 of 8 relapses also involved the CNS: 1 that was associated with a Ph-negative clone, 2 that occurred after allogeneic transplantation, and 1 that involved both the bone marrow and CNS. An IKZF1 plus signature was identified in 3 patients. Three patients (ages 74, 73, and 72 years) died after having had a complete haematologic response. Of these patients, 2 had a deterioration in their general condition (1 of whom had already stopped treatment) and 1 had status epilepticus.
A crossover from the control group to the intervention group occurred in 31 patients. Of these patients, 4 had an early crossover during the induction phase because of resistance to treatment (in 2 patients) and the development of an ABL1 mutation (in 2 patients). All the patients who crossed over from the control group were MRD-positive.
The median time to crossover was 6.4 months (range, 2.9 to 21.5). The median age of the patients was 51 years (range, 21 to 76), the median white-cell count was 18.9×10 9 per litre, and 9 patients had an IKZF1 plus signature. After crossover, MRD negativity occurred in 20 of the 31 patients (65%). At the time of the report, 1 of these patients had died, 14 had undergone transplantation, and 2 had a CNS relapse (1 after transplantation). The remaining patients are still receiving treatment.
Overall, 45 of 211 patients (21%) who had a first complete haematologic response underwent allogeneic transplantation: 29 of 149 (19%) in the intervention group and 16 of 62 (26%) in the control group. Two additional patients in the intervention group underwent transplantation after having had a second complete haematologic response. The median age of the patients was 48 years (range, 20 to 67) in the intervention group and 47 years (range, 20 to 62) in the control group; the median white-cell count was 25.2×10 9 per litre (range, 1.1 to 243.6) and 18.7×10 9 per litre (range, 2.8 to 73.0).
In the intervention group, 15 patients had an IKZF1 plus signature; of these patients, 11 were also MRD-positive. Of the patients without an IKZF1 plus signature, 15 were MRD-positive. Of the patients who had undergone transplantation during their first complete haematologic response, 4 died (2 of whom were >65 years of age). In the control group, 7 of 16 patients had an IKZF1 plus signature, and 5 of these patients were also MRD-positive. Of the 9 patients without an IKZF1 plus signature, 8 were MRD-positive. Two patients had both a haematologic and a CNS relapse after transplantation. No deaths had been recorded among these patients at the time of this report. In each group, 1 patient underwent transplantation based on medical decision.
A total of 294 adverse events (AEs) of grade 3 or greater were reported: 173 events in 85 patients in the intervention group and 121 events in 44 patients in the control group. In the intervention group, 79 severe AEs of grade 3 or greater were reported in 53 of 158 patients (34%).
The most frequent severe AEs were infections (31 events in 27 patients), decline in general condition (10 events in 10 patients), cardiovascular events (11 events in 9 patients), neurologic or psychiatric disorders (7 events in 7 patients), and hepatic disorders (6 events in 5 patients). In the control group, 61 severe AEs were reported in 37 of 78 patients (47%); the most frequent were infections (in 13 patients), haematologic side effects (in 10 patients), gastrointestinal disorders (in 7 patients), neurologic or psychiatric disorders (in 6 patients), and vascular events (in 3 patients).
In an accompanied editorial article, Dr. Adele K. Fielding of the Centre for Blood Research, Hull York Medical School, University of York in York, UK wrote that the study findings provide definitive evidence of a safer and more effective approach to the treatment of Ph-positive ALL that is free from the use of chemotherapy. This investigator-initiated study is compelling for the safety and efficacy of the interventional approach, but the treatment that the control group received may seem old-fashioned in well-funded health systems that allow off-label prescribing, but it is the way that most practitioners worldwide treat patients with newly diagnosed Ph-positive ALL.
Ponatinib is not routinely available or reimbursed for the treatment of newly diagnosed ALL. Blinatumomab does not have a marketing authorisation for patients with newly diagnosed Ph-positive ALL, despite the striking results from non-randomised trials and despite the fact that it is widely used in patients with Ph-negative ALL for persistent MRD after induction and for MRD-negative disease during consolidation. Furthermore, the overall costs of this new regimen remain beyond the budget of many healthcare systems.
The study was designed by GIMEMA together with the academic authors. Funding was provided by grants from Associazione Italiana per la Ricerca sul Cancro, Finanziamento Medi Progetti Universitari 2022, and Progetti di Rilevante Interesse Nazionale. Ponatinib and blinatumomab were donated by the manufacturers, Incyte Biosciences International and Amgen for the use in the study.

title: Are the benefits of peri-operative immunotherapy in resectable bladder cancer being called into question?
content:
Latest phase III data from KEYNOTE-866 and ENERGIZE show no improvement in event-free survival with the addition of peri-operative pembrolizumab or nivolumab to standard therapy
Practice-changing results from the NIAGARA trial , which were first discussed at the ESMO Congress 2024, showed that peri-operative durvalumab compared with neoadjuvant chemotherapy plus surgery led to a significant increase in respective event-free survival (EFS) and overall survival (OS) outcomes, 67.8% versus 59.8% and 82.2% versus 75.2% at 2 years. While more recent data had continued to support the use of the immune checkpoint inhibitor (ICI) in this setting, negative results from two phase III studies presented at the ESMO Congress 2026 (Madrid, 23–27 October) suggest that “the benefit observed with durvalumab in the NIAGARA trial should not automatically be interpreted as a class effect of peri-operative immune checkpoint inhibition combined with chemotherapy,” notes Dr Yohann Loriot from Gustave Roussy Cancer Institute, Villejuif, France.
Both the KEYNOTE-866 study and the ENERGIZE study have reported no statistically significant differences in EFS with the addition of a peri-operative ICI – pembrolizumab and nivolumab, respectively – to neoadjuvant chemotherapy in patients with cisplatin-eligible, resectable muscle-invasive bladder cancer (MIBC). At a median follow-up of 60.9 months, the double-blind KEYNOTE-866 trial reported a median EFS (primary endpoint) of 74.1 months in the pembrolizumab arm while median EFS was not reached in the placebo arm (hazard ratio [HR] 0.88; 95% confidence interval [CI] 0.71–1.10; p=0.1366) ( Abstract 4735O , key results in the box below). In the ENERGIZE study, median EFS was not reached in the nivolumab arm versus 67.6 months with chemotherapy at a median follow-up of 54.5 months (HR 0.94; 95.74% CI 0.71–1.25; p=0.6697) ( Abstract 4736O , key results in the box below). A lack of significant difference between arms was also reported for the co-primary endpoint of pathological complete response (pCR): 39.1% versus 29.6%, respectively (difference 9.5%; 99.91% CI –2.6–21.6).
“The NIAGARA study remains practice changing in that it demonstrated a clear and robust benefit in both EFS and OS with the addition of peri-operative durvalumab to neoadjuvant chemotherapy compared with chemotherapy alone. Discrepancies observed in the two studies presented at the Congress may be driven by biological or methodological factors,” explains Loriot.
Differences in trial populations, chemotherapy delivery, dose intensities, timing of surgery and duration of post-operative immunotherapy may contribute to the different outcomes. “It is likely that peri-operative efficacy will also depend on the interaction between the ICI and chemotherapy, treatment sequence, the molecule subtype (anti-PD-1 versus anti-PD-L1), PD-L1 status, disease stage and nodal status,” he surmises. “Detailed analysis of clinical and biomarker subgroups, including circulating tumour DNA (ctDNA) dynamics, will help clear up any doubts on how to use ICIs in the peri-operative setting.”
The potential role of this drug class for neoadjuvant and adjuvant treatment of MIBC does not appear to be challenged by several other studies. Phase III adjuvant trials like the AMBASSADOR (pembrolizumab versus observation) and the CheckMate 274 trials (nivolumab versus placebo) have previously reported significant disease-free survival (DFS) benefits in patients with MIBC after radical surgery ( N Engl J Med. 2025;392:45–55 ; N Engl J Med. 2021;384:2102–2114 ). The IMvigor010 trial with adjuvant atezolizumab versus observation showed no improvement in DFS, although patients with ctDNA-positive MIBC experienced an OS benefit with atezolizumab ( Lancet Oncol. 2021;22:525–537 ; Eur Urol. 2024;85:114–122 ). The IMvigor011 study subsequently reported improved DFS and OS with adjuvant atezolizumab in patients with ctDNA-positive MIBC, while those who were ctDNA-negative achieved an excellent prognosis without adjuvant therapy ( N Engl J Med. 2025;393:2395–2408 ).
Neoadjuvant studies have also previously reported clinical activity with pembrolizumab prior to cystectomy in MIBC, highlighting the benefits of immunotherapy prior to surgery ( J Clin Oncol. 2018;36:3353–3360 ) and atezolizumab ( Nat Med. 2019;25:1706–1714 ).
“Further progress in this field is likely to be driven by studies that combine antibody–drug conjugates (ADCs) with ICIs,” adds Loriot. For instance, the recent KEYNOTE-905/EV-303 trial in a cisplatin-ineligible population and KEYNOTE-B15/EV-304 trial in cisplatin-eligible patients reported significantly greater EFS and OS and a significantly higher pCR rate with peri-operative enfortumab vedotin plus pembrolizumab than with surgery alone or compared with neoadjuvant chemotherapy and surgery ( N Engl J Med. 2026;394:1257–1269 ; N Engl J Med. 2026;395:338–348 ).
“I think key emerging questions now relate to which patients need immunotherapy prior to surgery , who needs it after surgery, and can biomarkers such as ctDNA be used to avoid unnecessary post-operative treatment in patients who are cured by chemotherapy and cystectomy?” he concludes.

title: GSK的PD-1抗体Dostarlimab新适应症获FDA加速批准，拿下局部晚期直肠癌领域首个免疫疗法
content:
10月19日，葛兰素史克（GSK）宣布，美国FDA加速批准其抗PD-1抗体Dostarlimab一项新适应症，用于治疗II期和III期微卫星不稳定性高（MSI-H）/错配修复缺陷（dMMR）局部晚期直肠癌成人患者。图源：葛兰素史克官网据GSK介绍，Dostarlimab是美国首个且目前唯一获批用于该患者群体的免疫疗法。此次获批主要基于II期AZUR-1研究结果，数据显示，接受治疗的患者中，近七成持续实现完全临床缓解。一、II期临床数据公布，近七成患者持续缓解AZUR-1是一项全球性、开放标签、单臂注册性II期临床试验，共纳入154例既往未经治疗的II/III期dMMR/MSI-H局部晚期直肠癌患者。图源：摩熵医药-全球药物研发数据库研究评估了Dostarlimab单药治疗的疗效，给药方案为500mg、每3周一次静脉注射。主要终点为治疗后12个月内持续实现完全临床缓解（cCR12）的患者比例。研究结果显示，在可评估疗效的患者中：研究者评估：144例患者中，98例达到cCR12，比例为68%。探索性分析：144例患者中，110例在治疗至少1年后无癌症迹象，占76%。其中，98例未接受手术即达到cCR12，另有12例在手术后达到cCR12。独立中央审评：116例患者中，54例达到cCR12，比例为47%；另有38例仍处于12个月随访期，且已实现完全临床缓解。完全临床缓解意味着临床评估未发现肿瘤残留证据，并不等同于已证实治愈。此次研究结果为Dostarlimab在局部晚期dMMR/MSI-H直肠癌中的应用提供了进一步临床依据。二、年销售额超11亿美元，Dostarlimab持续放量Dostarlimab是一款靶向程序性死亡受体1（PD-1）的单克隆抗体，通过阻断PD-1通路，帮助恢复机体针对肿瘤细胞的免疫反应。该药于2021年4月首次在全球获批上市，此后逐步拓展适应症，应用领域涵盖子宫内膜癌、实体瘤及结直肠癌等。图源：摩熵医药-全球药物研发数据库销售方面，Dostarlimab在2025年实现全球销售额11.36亿美元，同比增长90.56%，成为GSK肿瘤业务的重要产品之一。此次直肠癌新适应症获FDA加速批准，有望进一步拓展其在肿瘤免疫治疗领域的应用空间。三、中国尚未上市，相关临床研究仍在推进除静脉注射剂型外，GSK还在开发Dostarlimab皮下注射剂型，目前正在开展针对子宫内膜癌的Ⅰ/Ⅱ期临床试验。在中国，Dostarlimab尚未获批上市。目前，该药针对结肠癌、头颈部鳞状细胞癌及非小细胞肺癌的Ⅲ期临床研究正在开展。图源：摩熵医药-全球药物研发数据库随着此次FDA批准落地，Dostarlimab在dMMR/MSI-H局部晚期直肠癌中的应用进一步拓展，其后续临床开发及在不同市场的注册进展值得关注。参考来源：[1] 企业官网/官方披露[2] 摩熵医药（原药融云）数据库扩展阅读：1. title: 石药集团/和铂医药巴托利单抗获批上市！进口1类新药破局全身型重症肌无力，FcRn抑制剂再添一员
content:
10月22日，国家药监局官网显示，石药集团/和铂医药申报的进口1类新药巴托利单抗注射液获批上市，用于治疗全身型重症肌无力（gMG）。图源：NMPA官网一、历经两次上市申报，巴托利单抗终于获批巴托利单抗（HBM9161）是一款全人源抗新生儿Fc受体（FcRn）单克隆抗体，可阻断FcRn与免疫球蛋白G（IgG）结合，加速体内IgG清除，从而减少致病性IgG介导的自身免疫反应。在全身型重症肌无力III期临床研究中，巴托利单抗取得积极结果。2021年1月，该药被CDE纳入突破性治疗药物程序。图源：摩熵医药-全球药物研发数据库巴托利单抗的权益合作始于2017年9月。当时，和铂医药从HanAll Biopharma获得包括巴托利单抗在内的两款创新生物制品在中国（包括香港、澳门和台湾）的开发、生产及商业化权益。2022年10月，和铂医药与石药集团全资子公司恩必普药业有限公司达成合作协议，在中国共同开发巴托利单抗。其中，和铂医药负责该药针对全身型重症肌无力的完整临床试验设计与执行，并根据产品年度净销售额获得分层销售提成。在上市申报方面，巴托利单抗注射液于2023年6月首次获NMPA受理，受理号为JXSS2300049。此后，因III期临床试验延期，相关申请被主动撤回。2024年7月，相关方重新递交上市申请，受理号为JXSS2400060。历经两年多审评，该药终于于2026年10月获批上市。图源：摩熵医药-全球药物研发数据库二、FcRn靶点已有多款药物获批，市场竞争持续近年来，FcRn抑制剂逐步成为全身型重症肌无力治疗领域的重要研发方向，国内已有多款相关药物获批。2023年7月，Argenx与再鼎医药合作开发的艾加莫德α获批进口。2025年3月，优时比的罗泽利昔珠单抗获批进口。该药是全球首个同时覆盖乙酰胆碱受体（AChR）抗体阳性和肌肉特异性酪氨酸激酶（MuSK）抗体阳性全身型重症肌无力患者的FcRn抑制剂。图源：摩熵医药-全球药物研发数据库随着巴托利单抗获批，国内全身型重症肌无力治疗领域再添一款FcRn靶向药物。后续其临床应用及市场表现，值得持续关注。参考来源：[1] NMPA官网[2] 摩熵医药（原药融云）数据库扩展阅读：1. 强生65亿美元押注的尼卡利单抗正式获NMPA批准上市，首个FcRn拮抗剂落地中国重症肌无力治疗2. 阿斯利康「戈鲁利单抗」国内申报上市，自免双抗新药剑指全身型重症肌无力3. 最新！和铂医药核心产品巴托利单抗（HBM9161)重新递交上市申请

title: Low rates of pathological complete response reported with trastuzumab deruxtecan in early breast cancer
content:
Findings from the TALENT trial, the first neoadjuvant study of an antibody–drug conjugate therapy in HR-positive, HER2-low early breast cancer, are sobering
Trastuzumab deruxtecan (T-DXd), a HER2-targeted antibody–drug conjugate (ADC) previously demonstrated improved progression-free survival (PFS) and overall survival (OS) compared with chemotherapy in the phase III DESTINY-Breast04 study of metastatic HER2-low breast cancer ( N Engl J Med. 2022;387:9–20 ; Nat Med. 2025;31:4205–4213 ). However, these positive outcomes do not appear to transfer to the early breast cancer setting, according to final results from the phase II investigator-initiated TALENT study evaluating neoadjuvant T-DXd, with or without endocrine therapy, in hormone receptor (HR)-positive, HER2-low early breast cancer presented at the ESMO Congress 2026 (Madrid, 23–27 October) ( LBA23 ). Low rates of pathological complete response (pCR) were reported in 132 patients: 7% with T-DXd alone (Arm A), 3% with T-DXd combined with anastrozole (Arm B) and 9% with T-DXd followed by chemotherapy (Arm C). Rates of pCR combined with near-pCR (residual cancer burden [RCB] 0/1]) were 16%, 17% and 17% in Arms A, B and C, respectively.
“None of the pCRs were observed after 6 cycles of treatment; all occurred after 8 cycles,” notes Prof. Peter Dubsky from Breast Cancer Center Central Switzerland, and University of Lucerne, Switzerland. The previous ABCSG 34 study of HER2-negative early breast cancer that reported an RCB 0/1 rate of ~13% with letrozole alone in patients with HR-positive breast cancer puts the current findings into context ( Eur J Cancer. 2020;132:43–52 ). “TALENT was not designed to formally compare treatment arms. Arm C was added subsequently, resulting in clear imbalances in baseline characteristics between groups, and there was no chemotherapy control. We also have to bear in mind that HR-positive disease is very difficult to treat with chemotherapy , so the bar has been set very high,” he cautions.
Chemotherapy is not a typical combination partner with endocrine therapy in early breast cancer and it may seem counterintuitive to add an ADC to anastrozole. However, crosstalk exists between the oestrogen and HER2 pathways, so that activation of the oestrogen receptor can downregulate HER2 signalling, and depletion of oestrogen may increase HER2 ( Breast Cancer Res Treat. 2023;201:387–396 ). “The anti-oestrogenic effects of letrozole could potentially increase HER2 levels, providing the rationale for T-DXd targeting,” he suggests. In the study, HER2 levels significantly decreased over time after treatment with T-DXd, but levels at baseline and cycle 2 were higher in patients with RCB0 compared with RCB1/2/3, suggesting that higher baseline HER2 could potentially be associated with pCR. Trop2 protein remained at the same level throughout. “This provides an insight into post-treatment dynamics over time and could help to define a subset of patients most likely to respond to HER2-directed therapy,” observes Dubsky.
High objective response rates observed across treatment arms: 62%, 66% and 72% in Arms A, B and C, respectively. Regarding safety, nausea and fatigue were the most common adverse events (AEs) across arms, and a total of 3 cases of grade 2 drug-related interstitial lung disease (ILD) were reported in Arm B and Arm C. Treatment Related Adverse Events (TRAEs) led to any treatment discontinuation in 10 patients across the three arms (2 in Arm A, 3 in Arm B, and 5 in Arm C). One patient death occurred in the T-DXd alone arm.​ “From a patient perspective, it would be useful to see data on surgical outcomes. For example, how many patients with a planned mastectomy were instead able to undergo breast-conserving therapy or had axillary preservation rather than axillary dissection?,” notes Dubsky.
pCR was not a pre-requisite for breast conservation in a cohort of patients from Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center; two-thirds of patients with objective responses to neoadjuvant therapy were able to undergo breast conservation rather than planned mastectomy, despite experiencing similar rates of pCR to the current study ( Transl Breast Cancer Res. 2024;5:13 ).
A limited number of other trials is currently investigating ADCs in HR-positive, HER2-low early breast cancer. The ongoing SASCIA study is evaluating sacituzumab govitecan versus physician’s choice of therapy in >1,300 patients with HER2-negative early breast cancer (including an HR-positive subgroup) at high risk of relapse after neoadjuvant chemotherapy, while the I-Spy2.2 study platform includes a patient subset with HR-positive, HER2-negative tumours treated with datopotamab deruxtecan ( Nat Med. 2024;30:3728–3736 ; J Clin Oncol. 2024;42:17(Suppl):LBA509 ).

小核酸药物在过去五年迎来了管线的爆发式增长，但高速推进的另一面是同样不容忽视的失败率。全球1368个小核酸项目中，处于研发失败、停滞或拒绝上市状态的有455个，失败率约33.3%。2021年以来，259个管线进入失败或停滞状态，其中64.4%终止于药物发现或临床前阶段。更值得深思的是，一些管线在临床试验中成功实现了靶点调控——poly(GP)下降了48%，ATXN2蛋白显著降低，外显子跳跃水平优于已上市药物——却依然未能走到终点。靶点被成功调控，并不意味着疾病进程能够被改变；药效成立之后，安全窗口与产品价值仍决定研发成败。本文内容整理自摩熵咨询《小核酸药物的下一站——全球研发演进、技术迭代与研发成败洞察》报告，结合摩熵医药全球药物研发数据库对全球小核酸项目全生命周期追踪能力，系统梳理近五年研发失败管线的结构性特征与代表性案例。摩熵医药数据库覆盖药物从靶点发现到临床终止的完整信息链条，为行业研究者识别“陷阱靶点”、理解失败逻辑、优化立项决策提供了可验证的数据底座。一、近五年小核酸药物研发失败管线：终止阶段与失败原因分布作为新兴生物技术，小核酸药物的开发仍存在诸多困难。据摩熵医药全球药物研发数据库统计，在全球1368个小核酸药物项目中，处于研发失败、无后续进展、拒绝上市等失败状态的有455个，研发失败率约33.3%。1. 研发失败风险前置近五年行业研发失败的风险呈现明显前置特征，大量管线的终止集中在早期转化与临床价值验证阶段。2021年以来，共有259个研发管线进入了研发失败状态，或是进入超过5年没有任何新进展的停滞状态。从研发终止前的进度来看，有167个管线研发终止于药物发现或临床前阶段，占比达到64.4%，其次是临床II期阶段，终止管线占比15.8%，小核酸药物的研发难点高度集中在早期转化与临床价值验证环节。数据来源：摩熵医药全球药物研发数据库小核酸药物前期研究向正式立项的转化概率较低，候选药物常脱靶导致毒性是重要原因之一。从整体研究终止的原因来看，早期研究未商业化/临床前未推进是占比最大的原因，合计占比32%。根据奥尼兰姆数据，约有40%的Galnac-siRNA候选序列在临床前的大鼠独立筛选阶段中因为肝毒性而被淘汰，而这一肝毒性是siRNA与非目标RNA发生seed区脱靶配对导致的，可见对于小核酸药物，靶向递送与精准识别是药物研发前期阻碍推进的重大壁垒。图片来源：摩熵咨询《小核酸药物的下一站——全球研发演进、技术迭代与研发成败洞察》2. 临床阶段小核酸药物推进壁垒临床阶段小核酸药物最大推进壁垒在于证明其临床价值。从不同研发阶段的终止原因分布来看，药物研发前期（药物发现、临床前）的管线，最常因战略管线优先级调整、早期研究未商业化等原因终止；而进入临床阶段后，因疗效不足、未达主要终点终止的管线占比开始显著上升。即便项目成功完成立项推进到临床，小核酸药物仍容易在临床阶段暴露临床获益不足的问题，这也表明行业在立项前的调研预测工作，仍然存在较大的优化空间。二、小核酸药物研发高失败率靶点分布在近年失败的259个管线中，有83个管线未公布其具体靶点。在剩余有靶点信息的失败管线中，涉及靶点135个，整体靶点集中度较低，较少有明显的“陷阱”靶点。但其中仍有20个靶点的开发失败率超过60%，ICAM1、SCNN1A等9个靶点失败率高达100%，体现出相当高的开发难度。1. DMD：研发热情与失败率双高DMD靶点同时具有高研发热情与高失败率。作为杜氏肌营养不良症的核心靶点，近5年有32个管线针对DMD进行研发，但失败率高达62.5%，有20个管线宣告失败。其中，BioMarin、WAVE Life Sciences曾分别将管线推进至II期与III期临床，但均因疗效不达预期而终止研发。2. TLR9：跨领域开发的高难度样本TLR9靶点作为免疫通路中的关键蛋白，近五年同样拥有较高的研发热情，目标适应症横跨癌症、呼吸系统、胃肠道、炎症、神经系统、免疫调节、皮肤病、肌肉骨骼系统与血液系统等多个领域，但其失败率同样高达62.5%（8个研发管线中5个失败）。Karolinska曾将对应药物cobitollmod推进至III期临床，但因无法达成临床终点而全面终止开发。三、小核酸药物研发失败代表性案例盘点梳理上述失败管线不难发现，两类问题最为典型：其一，靶点被成功调控，并不意味着疾病进程能够被改变；其二，药效成立之后，安全窗口与产品价值仍决定研发成败。以下四个案例，正是这两类困境的缩影。场景一：靶点调控实现，不等于疾病进程得到改善1. 案例一：WVE-004（C9orf72靶点，ASO）WVE-004是Wave Life Sciences开发的一款靶向C9orf72的ASO药物，适应症为C9orf72相关肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）和额颞叶痴呆（FTD），最高研发阶段为Phase I/II。C9orf72基因中的六核苷酸重复扩增是ALS和FTD最常见的遗传病因之一，其异常转录产物poly(GP)被认为具有神经毒性。WVE-004的设计逻辑是通过降解含有异常扩增的C9orf72转录本，降低poly(GP)水平，从而减轻神经毒性。临床前研究中，WVE-004能够有效降低患者来源神经细胞的poly-GP，且保留正常转录本；小鼠实验中，药品展现了长期药效，成功降低脊髓与皮层的poly-GP。2022年临床试验中，实验组出现了显著的poly-GP下降，但神经损伤标记NFL及临床功能没有显著改善，公司选择继续推进实验。2023年，在更多患者入组与进行更长期试验后，NFL与临床功能依然没有出现显著改善，公司宣布终止研发。研发时间轴：2018年：临床前研究2021年：启动临床I/II期2023年：临床结束，宣布终止研发失败启示：即使靶点调控获得预期结果，其距离最终疾病获益仍然有着距离。2. 案例二：BIIB105（ION541，ATXN2靶点，ASO）BIIB105是Ionis授权Biogen开发的一款靶向ATXN2的ASO药物，同样用于ALS治疗。ATXN2编码ataxin-2蛋白，其多聚谷氨酰胺扩增与ALS风险相关，被认为通过促进TDP-43蛋白的异常聚集参与疾病进程。临床前小鼠实验中，通过遗传学手段降低ATXN2或使用ATXN2 ASO均能显著降低TDP-43聚集并延长小鼠生存时间，展现出强大的临床潜力。图片来源：摩熵咨询《小核酸药物的下一站——全球研发演进、技术迭代与研发成败洞察》2020年启动的I/II期ALSpire研究（n=99）中，BIIB105实现了脑脊液中ATXN2蛋白的统计学显著降低。然而，在6个月的安慰剂对照期内，BIIB105未能降低血浆神经丝轻链（NfL）水平——NfL是神经退行性变和神经元损伤的标志物。功能、呼吸和肌力等临床终点同样没有改善。在超过40周的开放标签扩展随访中，ATXN2的持续降低并未转化为NfL或临床功能的任何改善。2024年5月，Biogen和Ionis宣布终止BIIB105的开发。研发时间轴：2013年：Ionis授权Biogen开发2020年：启动临床I/II期2024年：宣布终止研发失败原因：靶向机制明确且在人体内展现积极信号，但未能转化为疾病获益。失败启示：与WVE-004类似，即使设计的路径在动物模型中获得了积极结果，靶点调控也达到预期，但距离最终的患者获益仍存在较大差距。小核酸药物的新靶点开发仍然有着巨大的不确定性。场景二：药效达标，安全窗口与产品价值决定研发成败3. 案例三：SRP-5051（DMD外显子51跳跃，肽偶联PMO）SRP-5051（vesleteplirsen）是Sarepta开发的一款多肽偶联PMO（PPMO）药物，通过诱导DMD基因外显子51跳跃、恢复抗肌萎缩蛋白表达来治疗杜氏肌营养不良症。与WVE-004和BIIB105不同，SRP-5051在临床试验中展现了明确的疗效信号。在II期MOMENTUM研究的Part A中，SRP-5051观察到了显著的外显子跳跃和肌营养不良蛋白表达上升，且呈现剂量依赖关系，药物在试验过程中呈现良好的可耐受性，未出现显著的安全性信号。在Part B中，公司继续推高剂量，并于2021年观察到了显著优于已上市外显子跳跃药物的跳跃水平和肌营养不良蛋白表达水平。但随之而来的是安全性问题。早在研究早期，低镁血症（血镁水平偏低）的风险就已被识别，当时被判断为“可监测、可管理”。然而在后续研究中，部分患者出现了持续性的低镁血症，且即使在停药后仍然存在，同时伴有eGFR下降（肾功能指标恶化）。2024年11月，Sarepta宣布终止SRP-5051的开发，理由是长期安全性和耐受性的考量。SRP-5051的失败提供了一个与前述神经领域案例截然不同的教训：当疗效已经成立，安全窗口便成为产品价值的唯一裁判。外显子跳跃水平和肌营养不良蛋白表达的数据是令人鼓舞的，但持续性的低镁血症和肾功能下降意味着药物的治疗窗口过窄——在能够产生疗效的剂量下，安全性风险超出了可接受的范围。这一案例的核心启示在于：对于早期出现的安全性问题，应当尽早评估其剂量依赖性和可逆性，避免在研发后期因安全性风险积累而导致全部投入付诸东流。4. 案例四：Vupanorsen（ANGPTL3靶点，GalNAc-ASO）Vupanorsen是Ionis发现、辉瑞引进的GalNAc-ASO药物，靶向ANGPTL3，适应症为血脂异常与心代谢疾病，最高研发阶段推进至IIb期临床。ANGPTL3是一个经过人类遗传学充分验证的靶点——ANGPTL3功能缺失突变携带者具有较低的LDL-C、甘油三酯水平和冠心病风险。2016年的临床I期试验中，实验组体内ANGPTL3的表达下降83%，同时带来甘油三酯最大平均下降66%、LDL-C最大平均下降35%的显著结果。进入临床IIa期试验后，主要终点再次达标，甘油三酯相较安慰剂组下降约44%，non-HDL-C下降约18%，总胆固醇下降约19%，但LDL-C对比安慰剂组没有出现显著下降，脂肪肝、糖代谢指标等也没有得到显著改善。进入IIb期试验后，在加大药物剂量后获得了更显著的ANGPTL3与甘油三酯下降结果，但non-HDL-C仅下降约22-27.7%，LDL-C仅下降8%-16%，ApoB下降约6-15%，同时加大药量后出现了部分肝脏安全性问题，最终公司宣布终止研发。 title: Clinical activity of talazoparib plus enzalutamide demonstrated in patients with high-volume mHNPC, but without clear benefit over enzalutamide in biomarker-unselected oopulation
content:
Findings from the ZZ-FIRST study
In a prospective, multicentre, randomised phase II ZZ-FIRST study, conducted in patients with high-volume metastatic hormone-naive prostate cancer (mHNPC), the addition of talazoparib to enzalutamide demonstrated clinical activity; the trial met the primary endpoint, with a prostate-specific antigen (PSA) < 0.2 response rate (RR) exceeding the prespecified threshold in the interventional arm, although this was not significantly superior to that observed in the enzalutamide control arm. A trend toward improved efficacy in time-to-event endpoints was also observed in tumours lacking homologous recombination repair (HRR) gene alterations; however, the magnitude of benefit in this subgroup was modest.
Together with the correlative analyses demonstrating that androgen receptor pathway inhibition (ARPI) induces profound transcriptional reprogramming largely driven by proliferative suppression rather than functional HRR deficiency, these findings suggest against a broadly applicable biological rationale for extending ARPI-PARP inhibitor combinations beyond molecularly selected populations according to Dr. Joaquin Mateo of the Vall d’Hebron Institute of Oncology (VHIO), Vall d’Hebron Barcelona Hospital Campus and Vall d’Hebron University Hospital in Barcelona, Spain and colleagues, who published the findings on 14 October 2026 in the Nature Medicine .
The authors wrote in the background that in mHNPC setting, multiple phase III trials have reshaped the therapeutic landscape, demonstrating that intensifying androgen deprivation therapy (ADT) combined with ARPI significantly improves overall survival (OS) and delays progression to metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer (mCRPC). Additional strategies, including docetaxel chemotherapy, radiotherapy to the primary tumour and triplet regimens combining ADT, docetaxel and ARPI, have further improved outcomes in selected patient populations. Among patients with metastatic disease, those with high-volume mHNPC have the poorest prognosis despite treatment intensification.
Combining ARPI with PARP inhibitor has emerged as a promising clinical strategy in advanced prostate cancer. Randomised trials in mCRPC have reported improved outcomes with AR-PARP co-targeting; however, the magnitude of benefit varies across genomic contexts. While clinically meaningful benefit has been demonstrated in tumours harbouring BRCA1 / BRCA2 and other HRR alterations, results in patients with HRR wild-type prostate cancer have been inconsistent, with modest improvements in radiographic progression-free survival and no clear OS benefit.
More recently, randomised phase III trials have demonstrated clinical benefit for ARPI-PARP inhibitor combinations, including enzalutamide with talazoparib, in patients with HRR-altered mHNPC, reinforcing HRR deficiency as the best-established predictive biomarker for this therapeutic strategy. The biological basis supporting this combination approach beyond cases with HRR alterations remains, moreover, incompletely defined.
Preclinical studies have proposed multiple mechanisms of interaction between AR signalling and DNA damage response (DDR) pathways, including transcriptional regulation of DDR genes by AR that would lead to an impairment of HRR and accumulation of DNA damage after AR inhibition. However, these findings are not fully concordant across experimental systems, and their relevance in human tumours remains uncertain. Given the tight coupling between HRR activity and cell cycle phase, particularly during S/G 2 , it remains unclear whether transcriptional changes in DNA repair programmes observed in preclinical models after AR inhibition reflect direct modulation of repair capacity.
To address this gap, the researchers designed the ZZ-FIRST study which evaluates enzalutamide with or without talazoparib in patients with mHNPC and high-volume disease, including patients with or without HRR gene mutations with aim to investigate clinical activity and interrogate the biological mechanisms underlying response in this high-risk disease setting. ZZ-FIRST incorporates a short enzalutamide lead-in period before randomisation, enabling paired on-treatment biopsies to directly characterise early tumour adaptation to ARPI.
In total, 54 patients starting ADT received two cycles of enzalutamide lead-in before 1:2 randomisation to enzalutamide (17 patients) or enzalutamide plus talazoparib (37patients). The primary endpoint was met, with a 73% PSA < 0.2 ng ml −1 RR at 12 months in the combination arm (95% confidence interval [CI] 56-86%), exceeding the prespecified efficacy threshold (p < 0.001); the PSA < 0.2 RR in the control arm was 64.7% (95% CI 38-86%, p = 0.54 for exploratory comparison between arms).
Grade ≥ 3 adverse events occurred in 68% patients receiving the combination versus 35% with enzalutamide alone, predominantly anaemia (41%). Two fatal therapy-emergent myeloid neoplasms occurred in the enzalutamide plus talazoparib arm in patients with underlying genomic susceptibility.
Analyses of paired tumour biopsies acquired at baseline and during enzalutamide lead-in phase demonstrated marked tumour transcriptional reprogramming after AR inhibition, including suppression of proliferation-associated and HRR-related gene expression programmes, but without functional impairment of homologous recombination activity.
The authors commented that their integrated transcriptional and functional analyses provide biological context for the study findings. Although ARPI was associated with downregulation of HRR-related gene expression, this effect closely paralleled suppression of cell cycle and proliferation programmes and was not accompanied by clear evidence of impaired homologous recombination function in tumour cells. These data suggest that the apparent modulation of HRR transcription after AR inhibition largely reflects proliferative arrest rather than induction of an HRR-deficient state therapeutically exploitable through synthetic lethality.
The study provides integrated clinical and mechanistic insights into tumour adaptation to AR inhibition to inform the biological framework for ARPI-PARP inhibitor combination strategies in metastatic prostate cancer. While the talazoparib plus enzalutamide regimen was clinically active in patients with high-volume mHNPC, the study did not establish clear additional clinical benefit over enzalutamide alone in biomarker-unselected population and was associated with increased toxicity. Overall, the results refine the biological framework underpinning patient selection and the development of ARPI-PARP inhibitor combination strategies, particularly in earlier disease settings where a long-term benefit-risk balance is critical according to the study team.
ZZ-FIRST is an investigator-initiated study supported through grants from Pfizer and drug supply from Pfizer and Astellas Pharma. Correlative analyses were supported by grants from the US Department of Defense and Fundacion AECC.

title: Cell：肠道菌代谢物决定 CAR-T细胞成败！戊酸助阵、吲哚拖后腿，代谢风险评分可预测疗效
content:
Cell：肠道菌代谢物决定 CAR-T细胞成败！戊酸助阵、吲哚拖后腿，代谢风险评分可预测疗效
来源：生物谷原创 2026-10-21 10:47
这项研究为肠道微生物组在CAR-T细胞疗法中的作用提供了新视角。
免疫疗法，尤其是 CAR-T细胞疗法，近年来从根本上改变了癌症治疗，特别是某些形式的白血病和淋巴瘤。然而，并非所有肿瘤都同样反应良好，其原因仍未被完全理解。莱布尼茨免疫治疗研究所合作组 Innate Immune Sensing in Cancer and Transplantation 的一项新多中心研究现在表明，决定CAR-T细胞疗法成功的不仅是肠道微生物群的组成，而尤其是其代谢产物。
正如发表在 Cell 期刊上所述，某些微生物代谢物可以增强或抑制CAR-T细胞功能，对治疗结局产生重大影响。它们还为基于微生物组的疗法和旨在癌症治疗期间支持肠道微生物组的饮食策略提供了起点。
这项研究以来自 Munich (LMU)、Heidelberg 和 Regensburg 的 3 所德国大学医院的 129 名患者的观察性队列为中心。使用先进的微生物组和代谢组分析，研究团队鉴定了与 CAR-T细胞疗法应答或失败相关的肠道微生物组代谢物。
然后在小鼠模型和使用人类CAR-T细胞的临床前模型中测试了这些代谢物。这使研究人员能够分析它们对CAR-T细胞活性、代谢和疗效的直接影响，并首次更详细地阐明潜在生物学机制。
“我们的结果表明，单个微生物代谢物可以产生非常不同的影响，因此如果未来要利用肠道微生物组来预测或改善治疗成功，就需要具体考虑它们，”Hendrik Poeck 说。
特别值得注意的是短链脂肪酸戊酸：治疗前水平低与疾病进展风险更高相关，而治疗性给药改善了人类和小鼠模型中的CAR-T细胞功能。
相比之下，吲哚代谢物如吲哚-3-甲醛（Indole-3-carboxaldehyde） 和‌吲哚-3-乙酸‌（indole-3-acetic acid ） 水平升高与不利结局相关；这些代谢物在人类和小鼠模型中都降低了CAR-T细胞疗效。异戊酸，一种支链脂肪酸，被证明更复杂：它在某些方面改善了CAR-T细胞功能，但也与一种此前未知的促肿瘤作用相关。
微生物组复杂性：对免疫系统和肿瘤都有影响
这项研究为肠道微生物组在CAR-T细胞疗法中的作用提供了新视角。直到现在，研究主要集中在细菌组成上。这项工作反而表明，微生物代谢物是影响治疗成功的关键生物学角色。研究还表明，这些代谢物并非本质上就有益或有害；它们可以产生高度特异性、有时相反的效果。
“这些发现突出了微生物组的矛盾性和复杂性：它不仅影响治疗性免疫系统，也影响肿瘤本身，”Poeck 说。
“通过我们的研究，我们挑战了一个此前占主导地位的观点，并为微生物组研究和基于微生物组疗法的进一步发展开辟了新视角，”Dr. Dr. Markus Perl 说，他是第一作者，也是 University Hospital Regensburg 的医师。从长远来看，这些结果可能有助于通过靶向调节肠道微生物组来改善免疫疗法结局，例如通过微生物群转移或特定饮食策略。
“基于这些发现，我们目前正在 NCT-OCT2 项目中准备一项临床试验 CARBiome，研究在接受过抗生素并计划接受CAR-T细胞疗法的多发性骨髓瘤患者中进行微生物群转移，”Dr. Erik Thiele-Orberg, Ph.D. 说，他是该研究的共同最后作者。
Perl 补充说，这项研究还表明，“Regensburg 科学中心卓越的、具有国际可见度的前沿研究之所以成功，要归功于强有力的合作以及全世界许多敬业科学家的共同努力。”
微生物组研究转向生物活性代谢物
“这些发现将CAR-T细胞疗法中的微生物组研究从纯粹的细菌组成观点转向生物活性代谢物，”Dr. Severin Gütter 和 Dr. Simon Holzinger 解释说，两人都是该研究的共同第一作者。
“我们希望，聚焦细菌代谢物将能够在未来实现更稳健的治疗成功生物标志物。此外，这些代谢物的靶向治疗使用为未来治疗开辟了有趣前景，例如使CAR-T细胞疗法更有效。”
研究团队已经为临床应用提供了初步概念验证：一种基于代谢物的风险评分预测了对CAR-T细胞疗法的临床应答。下一步是与国家和国际伙伴合作，在额外队列中验证这些发现。（生物谷Bioon.com）

title: AstraZeneca的Ultomiris获FDA批准用于IgAN，新增第五个罕见病适应症【AI生成】
content:
阿斯利康（AstraZeneca）宣布，其药物Ultomiris（ravulizumab）获得美国FDA加速批准，用于治疗有疾病进展风险的原发性免疫球蛋白A肾病（IgAN）成人患者，以降低尿蛋白水平。这是该药在美国获得的第五个罕见病适应症。此次批准基于III期I CAN试验数据，显示在34周时，与安慰剂组5.6%的降幅相比，Ultomiris组24小时尿蛋白肌酐比值较基线降低46.6%，校正后的治疗效应为43.4%，且疗效早在10周即可见并持续至34周。作为C5补体抑制剂，Ultomiris通过阻断炎症核心驱动因子提供新机制。由于是加速批准，阿斯利康仍需通过评估估算肾小球滤过率（eGFR）的变化来验证其对肾功能的保护作用，以支持传统完全批准。该药源自2020年收购Alexion的交易，目前面临来自Tarpeyo、Filspari和Fabhalta等药物的激烈竞争。

title: 康缘药业中药1.1类新药十味安肠颗粒获批临床，靶向溃疡性结肠炎新赛道
content:
10月20日，摩熵医药中国药品审评数据库显示，康缘药业联合图锋医药、北峰药业及上海中医药大学申报的中药1.1类新药十味安肠颗粒获批临床，拟用于溃疡性结肠炎。图源：摩熵医药-中国药品审评数据库一、聚焦溃疡性结肠炎，康缘再推创新中药十味安肠颗粒由江苏康缘药业股份有限公司联合上海图锋医药科技有限公司、辽宁北峰药业有限公司及上海中医药大学共同研发，是一款基于中医临床经验方开发的现代中药颗粒制剂。据摩熵医药数据库显示，该药于2026年8月12日首次提交临床试验申请，受理号为CXZL2600075，并于10月20日首次获批临床。图源：摩熵医药全球药物研发数据库此次获批的适应症为溃疡性结肠炎。作为中药1.1类创新药，十味安肠颗粒后续临床研究进展及疗效、安全性数据值得关注。康缘药业在肠道疾病领域已有其他创新中药布局。公司另一款中药1.1类新药健脾疏肝固本颗粒此前已获得临床试验默示许可，拟用于腹泻型肠易激综合征（肝郁脾虚证）。两款产品针对不同适应症，体现了公司在中药创新药领域的持续布局。在成熟中成药方面，康缘药业拥有天舒胶囊、天舒片、苁蓉总苷胶囊等独家产品，属于神经系统疾病用药领域。摩熵医药数据库显示，天舒胶囊2025年全终端销售额超过2亿元，2026年上半年销售额约0.68亿元。

title: Blood Cancer Discov：三重靶向＋OX40增强＋6天快速制造！三特异性CAR T细胞疗法为复发难治B细胞血液癌症带来新希望
content:
Blood Cancer Discov：三重靶向＋OX40增强＋6天快速制造！三特异性CAR T细胞疗法为复发难治B细胞血液癌症带来新希望
来源：生物谷原创 2026-10-22 10:02
由俄亥俄州立大学综合癌症中心领导的一项I期临床试验结果显示，可能有一条途径可改善复发或治疗耐药性B细胞血液癌症患者的治疗选择。研究结果发表在Blood Cancer Discovery上。
研究人员得以在早期工作的基础上进一步推进，该早期工作利用CAR T细胞疗法增强B细胞血液癌症的治疗。所有血液癌症中约一半为B细胞血液癌症，包括淋巴瘤和某些白血病。
该试验测试了靶向3种蛋白——CD19、CD20和CD22的三特异性CAR T细胞疗法，并使用一种名为OX40的不同蛋白来增强患者的免疫反应。
“这是CAR T细胞临床试验首次使用OX-40来增强该过程并改善肿瘤杀伤，”该研究第一作者兼通讯作者Sumithira Vasu医学博士说。“我们试验的结果可能为那些B细胞血液癌症复发或治疗停止起效后选择有限的患者带来更好的治疗结局。”
团队还使用了一种更快的流程，在短短6天内完成细胞的采集、制备和回输给患者。这带来了积极结局，且患者副作用极小。
“此前有观点认为新鲜细胞回输更可取，而我们能够证明快速制造时间和新鲜细胞回输的可行性，”共同资深作者LHM项目成员Lapo Alinari医学博士、哲学博士说。“这在B细胞非霍奇金淋巴瘤中产生了有意义的临床活性且副作用极小，并在套细胞淋巴瘤、滤泡性淋巴瘤和弥漫性大B细胞淋巴瘤中实现了缓解。”
CAR T细胞疗法如何工作？
CAR T细胞疗法从患者免疫系统中取出抗癌T细胞，在实验室中修改这些细胞以增强其杀死癌细胞的能力，然后通过输注将细胞回输给患者。
该细胞疗法通常靶向在B细胞血液癌症中起重要作用的CD19蛋白。在此前的动物研究中，其他机构的科学家开发了一种同时靶向另外2种蛋白——CD20和CD22的CAR T细胞疗法，并显示出更强的有效性。
“尽管CAR T细胞疗法已经彻底改变了B细胞血液癌症患者的治疗，缓解率高，但许多患者会在CAR T细胞疗法后复发，且往往在第1年内，”Vasu说。“患者随后只剩下有限的治疗选择。”
该临床试验入组了18名中位年龄为64岁的患者，其中16人接受了OX-40蛋白增强的CAR T细胞过程治疗。所有入组患者在接受增强细胞疗法之前，此前均已接受过中位3种类型的治疗。
“虽然我们的试验显示，接受增强CAR T细胞治疗的B细胞非霍奇金淋巴瘤患者取得了令人鼓舞的结局，但仍需要在更大患者群体中进行更多研究，”资深共同作者Marcos de Lima医学博士说。（生物谷Bioon.com）

title: Walden Biosciences公布WAL0921治疗糖尿病肾病的II期研究积极数据【AI生成】
content:
临床阶段生物制药公司Walden Biosciences宣布其人源化单克隆抗体WAL0921在针对糖尿病肾病（DKD）的持续进行的II期研究中取得积极初步数据。WAL0921旨在抑制可溶性及细胞表面结合的尿激酶纤溶酶原激活物受体（suPAR/uPAR）系统的病理活性。数据显示，在接受治疗的12名可评估参与者中，有6人在第12周时尿白蛋白-肌酐比值（UACR）降低超过20%，应答者的中位降幅为32.4%。该结果证实了suPAR减少在蛋白尿性肾病中的概念验证，且安全性良好。这些发现已在2026年美国肾脏病学会“Kidney Week”会议上以海报形式展示。此外，I期数据表明WAL0921在健康志愿者中耐受性良好并能降低血浆suPAR水平。目前篮子试验预计将在未来几个月内报告原发性膜性肾病、局灶节段性肾小球硬化症（FSGS）和IgA肾病队列的蛋白尿减少数据。

title: 派诺生物三款疟疾多阶段疫苗伦理获批，将在澳大利亚启动I期首次人体（First in Human, FIH）临床试验！
content:
派诺生物三款疟疾多阶段疫苗伦理获批，将在澳大利亚启动I期首次人体（First in Human, FIH）临床试验
来源：生物谷 2026-10-22 15:51
Bellberry 人类研究伦理委员会批准派诺生物在澳大利亚开展首次人体临床试验，评估其针对恶性疟原虫和间日疟原虫的多阶段新型U-VLP®疟疾候选疫苗。
Bellberry 人类研究伦理委员会批准派诺生物在澳大利亚开展首次人体临床试验，评估其针对恶性疟原虫和间日疟原虫的多阶段新型U-VLP®疟疾候选疫苗。
派诺生物是一家致力于开发下一代疫苗、以满足全球未满足医疗需求的生物技术公司。公司宣布，其三款多阶段新型U-VLP®疟疾候选疫苗的I期首次人体临床试验（NCT07831226）已于2026年10月19日获得Bellberry 人类研究伦理委员会批准。
其中，LYB014针对恶性疟原虫（Plasmodium falciparum）生命周期中的三个关键阶段；LYB017针对间日疟原虫（Plasmodium vivax）生命周期中的三个关键阶段；而LYB027则同时针对恶性疟原虫和间日疟原虫生命周期中的上述三个关键阶段。这些候选疫苗将联合派诺生物自研的A02佐剂进行评估。A02是一种新型脂质体佐剂，其活性成分均为合成物质。
这项随机、双盲、对照、剂量递增的临床试验将在澳大利亚墨尔本的Nucleus Network Pty Ltd.开展，旨在评估上述疫苗在健康成年志愿者中的安全性和免疫原性。首例受试者入组预计将于2026年12月完成。免疫原性分析将与设于牛津大学儿科学系（Department of Paediatrics）的Draper实验室合作开展。
这些疫苗由派诺生物开发，旨在满足对新一代疟疾疫苗的需求。其设计针对疟原虫生命周期中的三个关键阶段，并期望通过预防感染、发病和传播，为未来消除疟疾的长远目标作出贡献。
尽管全球抗疟工作已取得显著进展，疟疾仍是严峻的全球性公共卫生威胁。2024 年，全球预估疟疾病例 2.82 亿例，死亡 61 万人。绝大多数病例由恶性疟原虫（P. falciparum）和间日疟原虫（P. vivax）两种主要疟原虫引发。两类疟原虫具备复杂的生命周期：携带病原体的蚊虫叮咬人体后，孢子体随之侵入机体并迁移至肝脏完成发育（第一阶段）；随后进入血液循环、入侵红细胞大量增殖（第二阶段）；部分虫体将分化至有性生殖阶段，当蚊虫吸食感染者血液时，虫体进入蚊体内继续发育，继而传播至新宿主（第三阶段）。
目前，世界卫生组织（WHO）批准使用的RTS,S/AS01和R21/Matrix-M疟疾疫苗仅针对恶性疟原虫生命周期的第一阶段，既往在儿童群体开展的 II/III 期临床试验中，仅展现出针对临床疟疾的部分保护效力。LYB014、LYB017和LYB027的研发理念在于探索：同时针对疟原虫生命周期各阶段以及/或覆盖多个疟原虫种类，是否能够提供互补且层次化的保护作用。该科学假说将在后续临床试验中进一步评估。
牛津大学疫苗与转化医学教授Simon Draper表示："我们很高兴能与派诺生物合作，共同开展这项首次人体临床试验的免疫原性分析工作。疟疾仍是全球重大公共卫生挑战，因此有必要持续探索创新疫苗策略，以在疟原虫生命周期的多个阶段提供更广泛、更持久的保护。"
"我们的科研技术有潜力变革抗击疟疾的方式，"派诺生物首席执行官晋博士表示，"我们开发的疟疾疫苗和A02佐剂的目标不仅是预防感染，更是要创造一个更强大、更可负担的防护盾，以应对抗疟原虫复杂的生物学特性，这可能是迈向最终消除疟疾的关键一步。"

title: Consensus-defined weight loss episodes arise in discrete intervals, are enriched around progression and associated with serologic signatures and somatic tumour genotypes
content:
Towards creating a multimodal atlas of cancer cachexia
By repurposing clinicogenomic measurements collected in the routine care of 52236 adult patients with cancer, the US researchers interrogated the clinical evolution and molecular basis of cancer cachexia through the analysis of weight loss episodes. By using longitudinally collected, multimodal dataset, they characterised how weight loss episodes present and evolve across cancers. Cachectic episodes clustered near periods of disease progression and were associated with inferior outcomes in nearly all cancer types.
Across diverse malignancies, cachectic weight loss episodes exhibited a consistent serologic signature characterised by lower albumin and haemoglobin and higher levels of liver enzymes. Numerous somatic tumour genotypes, including TP53 mutation across several diseases, were also associated with more frequent onset of cachectic episodes. Based on these discoveries, the study team produced novel, prospective models of the impending risk of meaningful weight loss in patients with lung, colorectal and prostate cancer. The results were published by Dr. Ed Reznik of the Computational Oncology Service, Department of Epidemiology and Biostatistics, Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center in New York, NY, US and colleagues on 12 October 2026 in Nature Medicine .
The authors wrote in the background that cancer cachexia is a paraneoplastic metabolic syndrome characterised by progressive, unintentional weight loss accompanied by muscle wasting that affects approximately half of all patients with cancer. Cachexia is associated with reduced quality-of-life, premature termination of therapy, increased treatment complications and elevated risk of death. Despite its prevalence and well-acknowledged consequences for morbidity and mortality, the underlying causes of cachexia are poorly understood.
Recently, murine and fly models of cachexia have identified tumour-intrinsic molecular events, circulating factors and behavioural factors that mediate cachexia and its severity. However, despite these advances, there remains a major gap in understanding the manifestation of cachexia, and its molecular underpinnings, in human patients with cancer.
This gap exists because of the heterogeneous application of clinical definitions, and because molecular studies of cancer largely focus on measurements of malignant tissue and fail to capture measurements of wasting in non-malignant muscle and adipose compartments affected by cachexia.
In this study, the researchers repurposed longitudinal clinicogenomic data from 52236 patients with cancer profiled by MSK-IMPACT (2010–2024) at Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center to define episode-resolved trajectories of consensus-defined cachectic weight loss and linked these events to outcomes, serology and tumour genotypes.
These episodes cluster around disease progression and are coupled to inferior outcomes. Integrating serologic measurements, the study team discovered characteristic and cancer type-agnostic changes in blood biomarkers that accompany these episodes. Through genomic analysis, they discovered that certain tumour genotypes, and especially the presence of TP53 mutations, are associated with an increased risk of cachectic episodes.
The study team further developed a multivariate model to predict impending risk of cachectic weight loss in patients with lung, colorectal and prostate cancer, validated in an independent, external cohort of 5785 patients from Dana-Farber Cancer Institute.
Previous human studies of cancer cachexia provided prevalence estimates for select cancers and some candidate biomarkers but lacked power to resolve temporal dynamics or genomic determinants. More recently, longitudinal analyses have quantified weight dynamics over time, and electronic health record-based machine learning approaches have been proposed for earlier identification of cachexia.
Cachectic weight loss episodes affected nearly half of all patients in the cohort, with diverse timing patterns. Whereas pancreatic and gastric malignancies showed early onset, others exhibited episodes later in the disease course or near treatment resistance. Consistent with longstanding clinical observations, gastrointestinal malignancies emerged as the cancers most strongly associated with weight loss episodes in studied cohort.
Tumour-intrinsic molecular features were also associated with episode risk. TP53 mutations were consistently linked to increased risk across multiple cancers, whereas ARID1A and KMT2B were associated with lower risk in specific diseases, suggesting that distinct oncogenic programmes modulate host systemic physiology. These associations point toward the interplay in which tumour genotype may influence inflammatory signalling, metabolic reprogramming or tissue cross-talk driving weight loss.
Building upon these findings, the study team integrated molecular and clinical variables into a predictive risk model capable of stratifying patients by their likelihood of developing episodes of weight loss. This model, although moderate in predictive power, highlights that risk can be quantified early and suggests a path toward incorporating cachexia surveillance into oncology practice.
Cachexia, like many paraneoplastic syndromes, is a physiologic phenomenon captured by simple measurements taken during routine clinical care. Many of the key discoveries reported in this study are direct consequence of careful analysis of otherwise routine data. Although contemporary cancer biology focuses on the molecular and cellular factors driving tumorigenesis, disease progression and response, the approach in this study motivates the alternative idea that clinical data itself can address major questions in cancer biology, at a scale that dwarfs molecular data and at no additional cost. Routine clinicogenomic data are, therefore, a scalable resource for discovery in cancer cachexia.
The authors also acknowledged that therapeutic exposure, as well as surgery and tumour resection, likely modify the risk of developing cachexia and its subsequent consequences. Sophisticated statistical models will be necessary to adequately capture the convolved effects of different combinations of therapy on cachexia and of cachexia on therapeutic receipt and efficacy.
In addition, the consensus weight loss definition further specifies weight loss that is unresponsive to conventional nutritional support, yet supportive care interventions such as nutrition counselling, supplementation and structured exercise programmes are not uniformly captured in the available structured data, precluding direct assessment or modelling of these exposures and their potential influence on episode detection. As with all observational analyses, the findings establish associations rather than causation, underscoring the need for prospective interventional studies to validate the mechanisms and biomarkers identified.
This work was supported by grants from the US National Cancer Institute, US National Institutes of Health, Department of Defense, a Kidney Cancer Association Young Investigator Award, the MSK Society and the Pershing Square Sohn Cancer Research Foundation. This work was also supported by Cancer Research UK.

小核酸药物正从罕见病与遗传病的小众应用场景，稳步拓展至肿瘤、心血管及代谢疾病等更广阔的疾病治疗版图，是当下创新药研发领域最具发展潜力的方向之一。该类药物以10—50个核苷酸组成的短链核酸分子为活性成分，能够突破传统药物“难以成药”的靶点壁垒，通过降解、沉默或抑制特定基因表达，从源头调控疾病发生机制，同时具备作用效率高、研发周期短、平台可复用等独特优势。当前小核酸药物已形成反义寡核苷酸（ASO）、小干扰 RNA（siRNA）、微小 RNA（miRNA）、适体（Aptamer）四大主流品类。依托化学修饰、GalNAc偶联、LNP包载、抗体/多肽偶联等多元化递送技术的持续迭代，其临床应用边界不断拓宽，全面覆盖肿瘤、眼科疾病、中枢神经系统疾病、遗传及罕见病、心血管及代谢性疾病五大核心领域，全球潜在市场规模约8500亿美元。凭借持续升级的技术体系与不断落地的临床价值，小核酸药物已然成为继小分子药物、抗体药物之后又一值得长期关注的新药研发热点。本文核心内容均摘编自摩熵咨询《小核酸药物的下一站——全球研发演进、技术迭代与研发成败洞察》报告。该报告依托摩熵医药数据库海量生物医药全产业链数据，从技术概览、行业沿革、市场格局、在研管线、终止研发管线等多个维度，系统梳理行业发展全貌，精准研判研发热点与潜在风险，深度挖掘赛道增长潜力。本文结合前沿技术特征与产业落地现状，系统整合并梳理了小核酸药物的技术体系、临床应用场景、主流递送技术及行业发展核心挑战。一、小核酸药物概览：技术分类与核心价值小核酸药物（small nucleic acid drugs）是由10—50个核苷酸构成的短链核酸分子，按药理载荷可分为反义寡核苷酸（ASO）、小干扰RNA（siRNA）、微小RNA（miRNA）与适体（Aptamer）药物等。作为核酸药物的一类，小核酸药物具有作用效率高、研发周期较短等特点，已成为新药研发领域的研究热点。1. 主要分类ASO（反义寡核苷酸）：结构上通常为单链的寡核苷酸；通过与靶RNA序列互补结合，实现RNA降解、剪接调控或翻译阻断的目的。siRNA（小干扰RNA）：通常为双链RNA；经RISC复合物介导，特异性降解靶RNA，实现基因沉默。miRNA（微小RNA）：miRNA类药物可通过模拟或抑制内源性miRNA，调控相关基因表达网络。Aptamer（适体药物）：化学本质常为DNA或RNA，通过特定三维空间构象与靶标结合，蛋白质是目前最常见的靶标。2. 作用机制小核酸药物的作用机制主要分为两类：（1）基因表达调控型：以ASO、siRNA和miRNA为代表，通过靶RNA识别，实现RNA降解或剪接调控，进而改变蛋白表达水平。（2）靶标直接结合型：以适体药物为代表，通过核酸链折叠形成三维构象，直接结合蛋白或细胞等靶标，阻断或调节靶点功能。3. 临床价值这种特殊的作用模式也赋予了小核酸药物显著的临床价值：它能够针对传统药物难以成药的靶点，大幅拓展疾病治疗的边界；序列设计具备天然的平台复用性，企业可以基于同一技术框架快速拓展新靶点与新适应症；在遗传病、罕见病及常见慢性病领域都展现出极高的应用潜力；部分成熟技术路线的产品还能实现数月一次的长效给药，部分前沿研究甚至在向接近一次性治疗的目标推进。4. 关键挑战目前小核酸药物行业仍处于高速发展期，技术落地与产业化仍面临多重瓶颈。首先，药物有效成分体内稳定性不足，极易被体内核酸酶降解，直接影响药效发挥；其次，组织与细胞特异性递送是行业核心技术瓶颈，严重制约药物生物利用率与靶向精准度；再次，药物应用存在脱靶效应、非特异性免疫激活及长期安全性未知等风险，临床应用安全性仍需持续验证；最后，药物生产工艺复杂，生产成本、质量控制及规模化量产的技术标准严苛，产业化门槛较高。整体来看，未来小核酸药物的行业竞争，将集中聚焦于靶点精准筛选、高效递送技术突破、用药安全性优化三大核心方向。二、小核酸药物的主要治疗领域小核酸药物横跨肿瘤、眼科疾病、中枢神经系统、遗传病及罕见病、心血管及代谢性疾病五大市场，潜在市场规模约8500亿美元，展现出广阔的应用潜力。图片来源：摩熵咨询《小核酸药物的下一站——全球研发演进、技术迭代与研发成败洞察》心血管及代谢性疾病（2400亿美元市场）：高胆固醇血症、高甘油三酯血症、高血压、血栓疾病等。遗传病及罕见病（2358亿美元市场）：血友病A/B、遗传性血管性水肿、肝性卟啉症、家族性淀粉样变多发性神经病等。中枢神经系统（334亿美元市场）：肌萎缩侧索硬化、运动神经元病等。眼科疾病（600亿美元市场）：地图状萎缩、年龄相关性黄斑变性、湿性年龄相关性黄斑变性、巨细胞病毒视网膜炎等。肿瘤（2864亿美元市场）：骨髓发育异常综合征、胰腺癌等。其他：角膜移植排斥、慢性疲劳综合征等。目前，小核酸药物已经在心血管及代谢性疾病、遗传病、罕见病等领域展现出较高的应用潜力。以肌萎缩侧索硬化（渐冻症）为例，该疾病由超氧化物歧化酶1（SOD1）基因突变引发，传统药物研发长期陷入困境，核心原因是SOD1蛋白结构高度稳定，无适配传统药物结合的作用位点，始终缺乏有效治疗手段。而小核酸药物托夫生（Tofersen）可直接靶向致病基因与RNA，从疾病根源干预病情发展，为渐冻症治疗开辟全新路径。该药物于2023年获批上市，2024年正式进入中国市场，落地惠及国内罕见病患者，充分印证了小核酸药物的独特临床价值。三、小核酸药物的主要递送方式递送技术被普遍视为小核酸药物研发的核心胜负手。当前上市产品以化学修饰及GalNAc偶联最为常见，同时以LNP（脂质纳米颗粒）及抗体/多肽偶联探索肝外靶向。1. 化学修饰直接给药主要用于ASO与适体药物，常见给药部位为玻璃体内、鞘内、皮下与局部。其核心逻辑是依靠PS／2’位修饰或PEG化增强稳定性，无需复杂载体。作为最成熟的技术路线，它特别适合局部用药或可直接到达靶组织的场景，代表药品包括Fomivirsen、Nusinersen、Tofersen（托夫生）与Pegaptanib。2. GalNAc偶联主要用于以siRNA为主、部分ASO的药物，靶向肝细胞ASGPR，可实现皮下注射、低频给药与明确的肝靶向，是当前肝靶向小核酸的核心平台。代表产品包括Givosiran、Lumasiran、Inclisiran（英克司兰钠）、Vutrisiran与Eplontersen。3. LNP包载主要用于以siRNA为主、部分miRNA及双链RNA的探索。其递送逻辑是包载保护核酸，促进细胞摄取与内体逃逸，适用于需要系统给药、需要额外包载保护的RNA载荷。其系统性递送验证充分，但产品数量少于GalNAc，代表产品为Patisiran。4. 抗体/多肽偶联主要用于ASO与siRNA，目标是突破肝外组织，聚焦肌肉、心肌及中枢神经系统；其核心价值在于利用受体介导内吞实现细胞定向递送。该路线临床推进较快，是肝外递送的重要方向，代表在研项目包括Del-desiran（AOC 1001）、DYNE-101等。需要补充的是，化学修饰是多数小核酸药物的技术基础，与LNP或偶联策略并非互斥关系——GalNAc-siRNA、LNP-siRNA通常同样采用2’位修饰及磷硫酰键等化学修饰手段。递送方式的演进也并非简单的代际替代，而是在用药便利性、靶向可及目标等方向上的持续拓展。除上述四种方式外，外泌体、无机纳米颗粒（金、氧化铁、硅等）等多种递送策略也处于探索之中。结语从首个反义药物问世，到GalNAc技术平台的成熟，再到抗体偶联递送向肝外组织进军，小核酸药物已完成从“概念验证”到“商业化兑现”的关键跨越。展望未来，靶点选择的精准化、递送系统的组织拓展化、化学修饰与安全性优化的持续迭代，将共同决定这一赛道的下一批赢家。对于身处其中的研发者与决策者而言，唯有建立在对全球研发数据持续追踪与深入洞察之上的判断，才能在技术迭代与研发成败交织的浪潮中把握先机。资料来源：1. 10月15日，NMPA官网显示，南京正大天晴制药申报的左卡尼汀咀嚼片获批上市，成为该剂型国内首仿。摩熵医药数据库显示，2026年上半年，左卡尼汀相关剂型在全终端销售额超过6亿元。在这一市场规模下，咀嚼片剂型迎来首家国内企业获批，南京正大天晴进一步丰富了其仿制药产品矩阵。图源：NMPA官网一、超6亿元市场，咀嚼片剂型迎来首仿左卡尼汀是一种参与人体能量代谢的药物，主要作用是促进长链脂肪酸进入线粒体进行β-氧化，为心肌、骨骼肌等组织提供能量。其原研企业为意大利阿尔法西格玛公司，左卡尼汀于1990年获得美国FDA批准上市，左卡尼汀注射液原研产品于1999年在国内上市。摩熵医药数据库显示，左卡尼汀注射液、片剂、口服溶液等相关剂型，2026年上半年全终端销售额超过6亿元，已形成一定的市场规模。

title: 石药集团首款三抗SYS6088与ADC新药SYS6062同日获批临床，晚期实体瘤布局双线加速
content:
10月15日，石药集团宣布，集团开发的SYS6088注射液和SYS6062均获NMPA批准开展临床试验，拟用于晚期实体瘤。图源：企业公告其中，SYS6088是石药集团布局的首个三特异性抗体（以下简称“三抗”），靶向PD-1、VEGFA和CTLA-4。随着这一产品获批临床，石药集团正式进入三抗研发赛道。一、首个三抗获批临床，聚焦三靶点协同SYS6088是一款PD-1/VEGFA/CTLA-4三特异性抗体，本次获批临床拟单药用于晚期/转移性实体瘤。摩熵医药数据库显示，该品种在2026年9月首次申请临床，10月15日，石药集团宣布获批临床。图源：摩熵医药-全球药物研发数据库从作用机制来看，该产品试图通过同时作用于三个靶点，协同调节肿瘤免疫微环境。其中，PD-1和CTLA-4均与T细胞免疫调控有关，VEGFA则参与肿瘤血管生成及肿瘤微环境调节。通过整合上述靶点，SYS6088旨在兼顾解除免疫抑制、促进T细胞活化与扩增，以及抑制肿瘤血管生成等作用。此外，该产品还对Fc端进行了改造，以降低潜在毒性风险并延长药物半衰期。据披露，临床前研究显示，SYS6088在多种恶性肿瘤模型中表现出抗肿瘤活性。至于其多靶点设计能否转化为临床疗效优势，以及安全性是否能够得到验证，仍有待后续临床研究回答。二、三抗与ADC同步推进，石药集团丰富肿瘤管线截至目前，石药集团已有70余款1类新药处于获批临床及以上阶段。除SYS6088外，石药集团另一款新药SYS6062也于同日获NMPA批准在中国开展临床试验，拟用于晚期实体瘤。图源：摩熵医药-中国药品审评数据库SYS6062是一款抗体偶联药物（ADC），通过抗体识别肿瘤细胞相关靶点，将细胞毒性载荷递送至细胞内，以发挥抗肿瘤作用。临床前研究显示，该产品在多种癌症模型中表现出抗肿瘤活性。从三抗到ADC，两款新药采用了不同的抗肿瘤策略。其中，SYS6088聚焦多靶点免疫调节，SYS6062则通过抗体实现细胞毒性载荷的靶向递送。

title: 齐鲁制药1类创新生物药QLS2401获批临床，靶向三靶点布局前列腺癌免疫治疗
content:
10月14日，摩熵医药中国药品审评数据库显示，齐鲁制药自主研发的1类创新生物药QLS2401注射液获得国家药品监督管理局药品审评中心（CDE）临床试验默示许可，拟用于治疗转移性去势抵抗性前列腺癌（mCRPC）。图源：摩熵医药-中国药品审评数据库QLS2401是一款同时靶向PSMA、STEAP1和CD3的三特异性T细胞衔接器（TCE）。其通过双肿瘤抗原识别与T细胞募集相结合的设计，探索前列腺癌免疫治疗的新路径。此次获准开展临床试验，意味着QLS2401进入临床开发阶段。其双靶点设计能否在肿瘤抗原表达异质性等情况下展现优势，还有待后续临床研究验证。一、三靶点设计，探索前列腺癌免疫治疗新路径转移性去势抵抗性前列腺癌是前列腺癌治疗中的重要挑战之一，患者仍存在未被满足的治疗需求。QLS2401采用三特异性T细胞衔接器设计，同时识别肿瘤相关抗原PSMA、STEAP1，并结合T细胞表面的CD3，旨在将T细胞募集至肿瘤细胞附近，激活T细胞介导的肿瘤杀伤作用。图源：摩熵医药-全球药物研发数据库与仅针对单一肿瘤抗原的策略相比，PSMA与STEAP1双靶点设计有望提高对不同抗原表达状态肿瘤细胞的识别能力，并降低单一抗原表达下降所导致的免疫逃逸风险。此外，QLS2401还通过优化CD3亲和力及肿瘤抗原结合设计，尝试在增强抗肿瘤活性的同时优化分子特性。不过，这些设计能否转化为更好的疗效和安全性，仍需临床数据进一步验证。二、临床前研究显示潜力，低抗原表达模型值得关注根据现有临床前研究数据，QLS2401在不同抗原表达水平的肿瘤模型中展现出一定的抗肿瘤活性。在PSMA或STEAP1中等、低表达的细胞模型中，QLS2401的杀伤活性优于同类对照分子。在细胞系来源异种移植（CDX）和患者来源异种移植（PDX）肿瘤模型中，该药也表现出抗肿瘤活性，尤其在低抗原表达模型中显示出相对优势。这些结果为QLS2401的双靶点设计提供了临床前依据，也使其在肿瘤抗原表达异质性方面的潜在价值受到关注。但需要指出，临床前模型的结果不能直接预测人体中的疗效。QLS2401能否在患者中实现有效的肿瘤控制，以及其安全性、耐受性和适用人群如何，仍有待临床试验回答。三、今年19款生物药获批临床，齐鲁制药持续拓展创新管线QLS2401的临床获批，也是齐鲁制药今年生物药研发进展的一部分。据相关统计，2026年以来，齐鲁制药已有25余款1类新药获批临床，其中19款为生物药1类新药。上述19款生物药中，13款为首次获批临床的新品，覆盖双靶点融合蛋白、双抗及多抗、抗体偶联药物（ADC）等多个研发方向。

title: ESMO Congress 2026 opened in Madrid: Spotlight on optimising cancer care
content:
ESMO is putting treatment optimisation at the heart of cancer care, aiming to reduce the burden on patients and healthcare systems and widen access to effective care.
New ESMO principles aim to humanise how cancer research is reported.
The congress will feature new data on mRNA cancer vaccines, antibody–drug conjugates (ADCs) and bispecific antibodies, among others.
The ESMO Congress 2026 opened today in Madrid, over 40,000 attendees expected, more than 6,300 abstracts submitted and around 230 sessions. At the Opening Press Conference, chaired by Angela Lamarca , Chair of the ESMO Communication Committee, ESMO set out how it is contributing to advance cancer care on two fronts: supporting the development of innovative treatments and making existing care more effective, less burdensome and more accessible.
ESMO President Fabrice André emphasised that treatment optimisation is aimed to reduce the burden on patients and healthcare systems, still without compromising outcomes. Shorter or less intensive treatment can also reduce costs and infrastructure requirements, widening access to effective care. “By decreasing the amount of treatment delivered for each patient, we are going to improve the overall outcomes for patients because this increases access worldwide to effective therapies,” he said.
Treatment optimisation is a priority in the ESMO Roadmap 2030 , supported by its Clinical Trials Funding initiative for independent academic research, including trials investigating how to reduce the amount of treatment patients need. André stressed that these trials are among the most difficult to conduct, and that academic groups, public funders and scientific societies have a responsibility to lead them.
ESMO has also introduced its Principles for Humanising Scientific Reporting , developed with the contribution of patient organisations. These principles fit with the concept of patient-centred oncology outlined in the ESMO Roadmap 2030. The principles aim to help doctors and scientists link research results to the people behind the data, recognising that behind the survival statistics are individual patients and families. “We want to reconnect scientific reporting with the fact that we are talking about human beings,” said André.
On the innovation front, mRNA cancer vaccines are a major theme of this year’s congress, with the INTerpath-001 trial in melanoma to be presented in Saturday’s Presidential Symposium. André described mRNA vaccines as a new treatment modality that could open the door to new possibilities for patients, while James Larkin , ESMO 2026 Scientific Co-Chair, stressed the need for well-designed trials across different cancers. “What we’re seeing here is the application of a technology, which was transformational during COVID, now being applied to the treatment of early-stage cancer,” said Larkin.
Yelena Janjigian , ESMO 2026 Scientific Co-Chair, highlighted new randomised phase III data on ADCs, which deliver chemotherapy more precisely to cancer cells. She also pointed to advances in ADC payloads and targets, as well as bispecific antibodies. “What you will see at the meeting this year is not just discovery projects, but randomised phase III data showing that survival is improved with these novel drugs,” she said. Janjigian also emphasised the importance of recognising and managing ADC-related side effects.
The international breadth of oncology research is clearly reflected throughout this year's congress. Janjigian said international representation was a priority when choosing the congress track chairs, and André noted the growing contribution of Asia, particularly China, to the development of new cancer drugs and clinical trials. “What ESMO does incredibly well is bring a truly international community together,” said Janjigian. “People come from all over the world with one focus: how to cure patients.”

title: 明尼苏达州农村医院运营危机：归咎于药企与保险公司并呼吁关注非营利机构生存【AI生成】
content:
明尼苏达医院协会（MHA）周二举行新闻发布会，警告该州农村非营利医院的财务安全正面临严峻威胁。MHA主席兼首席执行官Rahul Koranne指出，尽管整体资金可能充足，但未能有效流向非营利护理提供者。报告显示，2024年有28%的明尼苏达州医院在提供医疗服务时亏损，而2019年至2024年间医疗总成本增长了30%。医院负责人将困境主要归咎于制药公司和保险公司的行政“强制规定”及高价策略，称这些行业中的“逐利公司”通过操纵药物、医疗用品和技术价格，抵消了医院为维持运营所做的成本削减努力。Winona Health System CEO Rachelle Schultz表示，若无内部降本措施，其系统成本涨幅将接近30%，其中药品成本涨幅尤为显著。此外，服务线关闭现象频发，数据显示仅不到一半的农村医院仍在提供产科服务；Cloquet地区的Community Memorial Hospital在过去五年内已失去老年服务、家庭护理、临终关怀和心脏科服务，并暂停了分娩服务。随着联邦资金削减即将生效，这一危机预计将进一步加剧。
